scope: All814 frozen programmes (unmeasurable NA) and3 fixed DDIT3 RNA readouts across19 GSE273952 libraries. Mixed spots; not cell-intrinsic states.
graph: Six immediate Visium hex neighbours within library; author-folded regions excluded; no self edges.
primary_programme_descriptor: Moran I of continuous programme scores after logRNA/logdetected and categorical author TLS/tumour-region adjustment within each library. Descriptive only.
primary_LR_descriptor: Partial Spearman between neighbour mean NAMPT logCP10K and each fixed receiver-target RNA readout, controlling own NAMPT, both ITGA5/ITGB1 logCP10K, own RNA/detected, author TLS/tumour categorical regions. No cell-pair assignment or binding claim.
sensitivity: Add old six-major fractions (five with Epithelial fixed reference). This lacks endothelium/fibroblast and is explicitly incomplete; not accepted full composition correction. Spatial x/y polynomial gradient adjustment separately.
model_gate: Full rank with numerical condition number below1e8 and residual df at least100, every endpoint has variation. No data-selected removal of required covariates.
summary: Every library retained privately; public only cohort medians/IQR/min/max/positive-negative counts and leave-one-library median range. No pvalues or inferential CI: patient independence not reviewed and spatial RNA association alone is not mechanism.
unknown: Missing author region remains UNKNOWN; unmeasurable programme remains NA. Folded regions excluded only by author label. No high-low score threshold.
partial_composition_covariates: five legacy fractions, Epithelial fixed reference; total abundance unavailable and not fabricated
